templates.body: Hello {{name}}, winter freezing temps have arrived at SaveThePaws! Help us heat the wolf sanctuary shelters today at https://savethepaws.org. Reply STOP to unsubscribe.

Hi {{name}}, temperatures drop to -5° tonight. We are halfway to our heating goal for the rescued animals at SaveThePaws. Every $10 keeps a pen warm: https://savethepaws.org. Reply STOP to unsubscribe.

Final call {{name}}: sanctuary winter heating installation starts tomorrow morning. Protect our wolves from extreme frostbite at SaveThePaws. Donate: https://savethepaws.org. Reply STOP to unsubscribe.
